title: Relevant reasoning in limited English
description: Authored example: relevant evidence can appear without polished grammar. This is not a language-level classification.

steps.studentText: They make agreement because hurt worse than doing hurt good for them. I think justice still matter. Person deserve fair even nobody reward. Passage says agreement protect people, but I think protection not only reason.

observations.quote: They make agreement because hurt worse than doing hurt good for them.
observations.explanation: The student explains the relation between the harm of suffering injustice and the agreement.

observations.quote: I think justice still matter. Person deserve fair even nobody reward.
observations.explanation: The student states that justice matters without reward and gives fair treatment as a reason.

observations.quote: Passage says agreement protect people, but I think protection not only reason.
observations.explanation: The student distinguishes the account’s protective benefit from their own reason for valuing justice.
